assessment.reason: Only one strictly pre-anchor observation was analysed for each completed Sentinel series, so no pre-anchor EO trend can be established.
assessment.post_anchor_observation: Sentinel-1 R166 broad-area raw bright-scatterer candidates declined by about 19-24% from 2026-02-28 to 2026-03-12 across three tested CFAR thresholds. Pair-specific static-like suppression gives about 22-26%, but those retained counts are not one unified three-date series.
assessment.event_time_alignment: The 2026-02-28 Sentinel acquisitions are aligned only to the anchor date, not to a verified exact event time; no within-day before/after ordering is claimed.

sentinel_1_r166.interpretation: The anchor date did not show a broad-area candidate collapse; a moderate decline appeared by 2026-03-12. Counts are not confirmed vessels and are not directly comparable to daily chokepoint AIS counts.

sentinel_2_40rep.interpretation: The 16-to-11 difference must not be interpreted as a vessel-count decline because visual is a rendered 8-bit product, 10 m pixels miss or merge targets, and glint, waves, wakes, clouds, platforms and rendering drift can change detections.

highest_priority_pending_test.reason: The 2026-02-26 acquisition is approximately 34 hours before the anchor and is the closest independent EO observation to the AIS fleet-composition anomaly.

global_fishing_watch.reason: The 2026 window requires an authenticated account/token; the anonymous ArcGIS mirror ended at 2025-12-31.

reproducibility_status: result_snapshot_only; raw rasters, complete analysis programs, AOI masks and content SHA-256 values are not committed in this case package
